name: geoname_id
sql:
(ip) -> toUInt64 (
  multiIf (
    isIPv4String (ip),
    dictGetUInt32 (
      'akamai_geoip_city_blocks_ipv4',
      'geoname_id',
      tuple (
        IPv4StringToNumOrDefault (toString (assumeNotNull (ip)))
      )
    ),
    isIPv6String (ip),
    dictGetUInt32 (
      'akamai_geoip_city_blocks_ipv6',
      'geoname_id',
      tuple (
        IPv6StringToNumOrDefault (toString (assumeNotNull (ip)))
      )
    ),
    0
  )
)
